title: Dark mode surface colors
body: The new --surface-gray-* CSS variables were only added to the light theme block in globals.css. Dark theme should also have corresponding --surface-gray-* values so that landing page components respond correctly to dark mode toggle.
rationale: Users switching to dark mode will see the landing page fall back to the CSS variable being undefined, causing text/background colors to break.

title: sky/purple/amber/red/green Tailwind classes not mapped to design tokens
body: Several accent color Tailwind classes remain unmapped: text-sky-700, text-purple-700, text-amber-600, text-red-400, text-green-500, bg-sky-50, bg-purple-50, border-sky-200, border-purple-200, hover:border-sky-500, hover:text-sky-600, bg-green-400. These appear in ComparisonSection, OnboardingOverlay, NavigationBar, TabsSection, HeroSection. The sky/purple scales I added to tailwind.config.mjs cover some but not all (e.g., sky-700, purple-700 are not in the new config).
rationale: Accent color classes outside the 50-600 range may render incorrectly or use default Tailwind values rather than design system values.

title: green/red/amber accent colors not in design token config
body: ComparisonSection uses text-red-400 and text-green-500 for check/x icons. These semantic status colors are not mapped through the design token system — they still use raw Tailwind palette values.
rationale: Red/green/amber are semantic status colors that should have design token equivalents for consistency with the project's color system approach.
